title: [CON-4] Shared channels need two COs' `billingSig` on one announcement, but the format allows one
description: Review finding CON-4: Shared channels need two COs' `billingSig` on one announcement, but the format allows one (lens CON). Location: spec/08-cross-space.md:98; spec/05-messaging.md:204. Fix: Let `billingSig` carry one §13.1.1 entry per agreement under which the chain is registered (§13.1.1 already supports multi-signer `sig`). State that the guest CO authorizes on the basis of the `ChannelShareAgreement` plus its own member list. This depends on the CON-2 fix that turns the announcement into a typed envelope. Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
